policyPostgres.title: postgres
policyPostgres.description: A PostgreSQL connection. The URL carries no password: it names the environment variable that does. Frozen from truvity/policy v1.44.0 (version 1 of this document names a secret by its environment variable, `...Env`, which the shared fragment no longer has).

allOf.description: No password in the user information: postgres://user:password@host is refused, postgres://user@host is not.
No password as a query parameter: password= and sslpassword= are refused. passfile= is allowed, because it names a file rather than carrying a secret.
No percent-encoded parameter name: a driver decodes the name before it reads it, so %70assword= is password= by another spelling.

url.description: A connection URL without credentials, for example postgres://user@host:5432/dbname?sslmode=require. A password in the user information or in a password or sslpassword parameter is refused: the file is rendered into objects people read, and the password belongs to passwordEnv.

passwordEnv.description: The NAME of the environment variable holding the password. Unset means the connection needs none.

maxConnections.description: Pool size for this instance. Sized against the server's limit divided by the number of instances, not guessed.

postgres.description: A PostgreSQL connection. The URL carries no password: a password in it is refused, and `passwordEnv` names the environment variable that holds it.

description: The configuration of `audit migrate --config`, which applies the schema and grants each part's database role what it needs and no more. Secrets are never in this file: a field named ...Env holds the NAME of the environment variable that holds the secret. Telemetry is the OTEL_* environment, not configuration.

apiVersion.description: The version of this document's shape, `truvity.github.io/audit-migrate/v1`. Absent is the same; another value is refused, so that a later shape arrives by a version and not by a file that quietly means something else.

observe.description: A role to grant what the indexer needs: read and write on the index and its cursors, and the creation of monthly partitions through one function. Must exist and be none of the other roles.

purge.description: A role to grant what the purge job needs: to delete from the index and the deduplication table. Must exist and be none of the other roles.

reader.description: A role to grant what the query service needs: usage on the schema and select on the index's tables, and nothing else. The role must already exist and must not own the tables.

writer.description: A role to grant what the write path needs: the deduplication table, the catalogue registry and the key directory, and none of the index. Must exist and be none of the other roles.
